notes.title: The Ratatoskr Update is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Are you ready, Squirrel Squad?[/h2]

A new rival arrives and joins forces with Mother & Father to destroy the neighborhood! Commanded to whip up a cyclone that wreaks havoc in the neighborhood, Ratatoskr awaits our hero Squirrel atop the debris at the Golden Acorn Tree. Can Squirrel overcome this new challenge and defeat Ratatoskr to save the neighborhood?  

[h3][b]Watch The Ratatoskr Update trailer!
[/b][/h3][previewyoutube=E6SyairX7oU;full][/previewyoutube]

Tackle the new Super Platforming Challenge as you reach new heights navigating the cyclone debris to take on the new boss. But keep a sharp eye—those pesky agents are very motivated to take you out before you get there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/f3daad8bd1514f610f34c7b14d2a291e684e8731.jpg[/img]

The fight against Ratatoskr is quite unlike the vehicle-based bosses you've faced before. The mythical squirrel moves fast, has a variety of ranged and melee attacks, and is a considerably smaller target! Fortunately, you will be granted a special SMG with a magazine of infinite bullets for the occasion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/374a8618f592b751fee490d2ac7893f66d9cc8d1.jpg[/img]

Though it is a disputed feature among historians, we wanted our adaptation of Ratatoskr to make use of a horn/tusk in combat. It can use the horn/tusk as a devastating frontal attack, or drill into the ground and burst out from under the player. It can even grow in size and be used as a melee weapon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/c3251175f34bcf44d70a0d3757486c845d30ec7a.jpg[/img]

Our hero squirrel is not one to comprehend intricacies like blocking and dodging, but it definitely knows a thing or two about shooting! Using the gun and quick reflexes, you will be able to block and even deflect attacks back at Ratatoskr.

[b][h3]UPDATE 1.4.3.0: [/h3][/b]
[b]New levels: [/b]
[list]
[*] Super Platformer level
[*] Ratatoskr boss fight
[/list]
[b]New Outfits: [/b]
[list]
[*] Cauldron outfit (a la Getting Over It) as a reward for beating the Super Platformer with less than 5 deaths 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/dd1a583844524e2eeb26c2281d61bf6df446b0df.jpg[/img]

[*] "Chained" outfit (a la Chained Together) as a reward for beating the Super Platformer with 0 deaths

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/a6d79bcb8e733769bb15fd5f60f5d27922e3c319.jpg[/img]

[*] Corrupted Norse Squirrel, awarded for beating Ratatoskr

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/159dd228644a935ad779ae7e880b8aae2a5430fc.jpg[/img]

[*] Divine Norse Squirrel, awarded for beating Ratatoskr 3x and then a 4th time, where he will be gold and more difficult

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/fb489ca9fb2a609662a3a96d34fa003a23685e75.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b][h3]Do you have what it takes to take on Ratatoskr? Play the update now to find out! 
[/h3][/b]

notes.title: Introducing the all-new Photo Mode!
notes.content:
Squirrel With A Gun's Photo Mode allows players (Squirrels) to take a screenshot of whatever zany situation you have managed to pause.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/31b413f3fbd701766974e19a5a33e7ae1cb08d67.jpg[/img]
In [b]"Cam Adjust" mode[/b], you will be able to freely move and turn the camera and even give it a "dutch" angle for dramatic effect. Players can also zoom in/out the camera's Field of View (FoV) to fit your needs.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/0df534a6985c47a3b0126bd41886a3d769efb92c.jpg[/img]
In[b] "Focus" mode[/b], the player can adjust the camera's focus to emulate professional photography. 
[list]
[*] By default, focus is disabled and everything is sharp.
[*] When the focus is set to "player," the camera will automatically focus on our squirrel hero, as it does during gameplay.
[*] When the focus is set to "manual," the player has full control over the focal distance. This is useful for shots where you might want a citizen in focus and the squirrel blurry.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/0bdd01c7f91d192a0714517c698a56a47ce24291.png[/img]
In [b]"Filter" mode[/b], the player can add silly photo filters to the scene, which can change the color, or put an effect on nearby human and squirrel faces (and you can toggle this effect for player only, NPC only, or both). There are 15 photo filters to collect around the world....can you find them all?

Photo mode is a free update for all, so be sure to update and play today to show off all your Squirrel lewks! 


[h3]Stay tuned for more exciting free updates to come: 
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/29c2b931dff3a9210d808d1aea79d386b281d597.png[/img]

notes.title: The Post-release Free Content Roadmap is here!
notes.content:
Hellloooo Squirrel Squad!

Get ready to go nuts because today, at this very moment, we’re unveiling our post-release Squirrel With A Gun Content Roadmap! Yep, you’ve heard that right—the game's launch is just the beginning. Once Squirrel With a Gun is out, we’re not stopping with production and we’ve got a stash of [b]FREE updates [/b]coming your way. 

Curious to know more? You are!? Perfect. In that case let’s cut to the intro music, show that flashy logo animation, and…. let’s go!

Squirrels, feast your eyes on the [b]SEVEN incredible post-release updates[/b], all coming to you for free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/29c2b931dff3a9210d808d1aea79d386b281d597.png[/img]

[list]
[*] First up, we will introduce [b]Photo Mode[/b] with a free-roaming camera. From daring stunts to stylish poses, show off your squirrel psycho-cool moments in stunning snapshots with the all-new free roam camera. In short, the chaos is  getting cinematic. 
[*] Next is the [b]Super Platforming Challenge level[/b]. This thrilling new level is designed to push your gun-jumping prowess to the limit. 
[*] Around that same timing, you will also get [b]A New Rival[/b]. Just when you thought you had the city (and agents) under control, a mysterious new threat emerges. 
[*] Early next year, the [b]Outfit Variety Pack[/b] is coming your way. Expect a range of swanky new costumes to keep you looking sharp and stylish. 
[*] Spring 2025 will bring the [b]Gravity Gun[/b], a game-changing gadget from the lab that lets you manipulate objects with gravity (imagine the chaos)! 
[*] June 2025 will bring the [b]Squirr-LGBT [/b]update which features a set of pride fits. Be gay, do crime! (Just like squirrels. Yep, look it up—Squirrels can be gay AND do crime.)
[*] And finally, in Summer 2025, a set of new furs will transform your Squirrel into other adorable forest critters. We call this update [b]The Varmint Collection[/b]. Let’s get wild. 
[/list]
[i]Keep in mind that those dates are not final and may change. It is video game development afterall. 
[/i]

We hope that these updates have you as hyped as we are for what's to come. Just five more weeks until we can commit Squirrel crimes together on [b]August 29[/b]!

We’ll be sharing more updates with you as we get along to the finish line, so don't forget to join our Squirrel Squad and follow us on [url=https://x.com/QuiteDan]X[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@maximumentmt]TikTok[/url] for the latest news, sneak peeks, and more content from the game.

Stay nutty, and see you soon!

notes.title: Weapon Showcase: The Sniper Rifle!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, Squirrel Squad![/h2]

The last, but certainly not least, weapon in our showcase is the [b]Sniper Rifle[/b]! 

Post up on a squirrely vantage point with the semi-automatic sniper rifle to take out enemies long distance. The sniper rifle performs an epic takedown on enemies, even if they’re far away. When platforming, utilize the sniper gun jump for an extreme vertical boost. Its powerful kickback can even knock down nearby baddies. 

Pro tip: Take down a certain boss from above by finding the sniper rifle up in the scaffolding and aiming for weak spots.

notes.title: Squirrel With A Gun 2023 Dev Log [02]
notes.content:
Hello again, folks! 🔫🐿️ Thought I'd share some Squirrel With A Gun progress.

First off I had a little interview with the fine folks at [b]Game Rant![/b] 
We discuss the inspiration, challenges and more. Check it out!
[url=https://gamerant.com/squirrel-gun-interview-solo-development-gun-puzzles-unreal/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/df0cbf4f40d637000045d67e3e5ea6678b2b1007.png[/img][/url]

As far as new features...
[previewyoutube=scQ01ztUd7Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Added a neck snapping takedown for when you get to their nape unspotted (No, they can't feel it crawling up their back. Squirrel is JUST. THAT. SNEAKY.)

[b]If you don't mind "puzzle" spoilers,[/b] here's a video of squirrel using the neck snap in a positive way to get a Golden Acorn:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=awduwKIT_nc


[previewyoutube=ccIR7dO5q-4;full][/previewyoutube]
One of the biggest additions is an outfit customizer. There are 3 different parts: Clothing, Accessory (usually a hat), and Fur color. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42666094/ee306850ae118b8a96e82270e68b300ce59f356b.png[/img]
Some outfits even have special qualities. The bomb suit here makes you nearly immune to explosions (at the cost of speed). The bomb suit helmet (Accessory) allows you to exhume landmines without detonating them. Speaking of: there are landmines now!


[previewyoutube=skSytmJau4Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Enemies are now capable of aiming and shooting. Here's a blooper of an agent aiming a shotgun and shoot himself. This is because the "bullet" spawn point was at the trigger, instead of the tip of the barrel (it's fixed now). 
Hey, speaking of shotguns....

[previewyoutube=MX5eIAsLHLM;full][/previewyoutube]
We've got some shotgun mechanics working. It can ragdoll enemies and even blast away locked doors!

Aside from that, there's a lot of AI improvements, enemies have HP bars, and they can stand back up after being ragdoll (if they're not dead, of course).

Until next time, Squirrel Squad!
